_meta.description: Morphological rule data for the Viracnon segmenter. Every item here is taken from the project brief's 'Base morphology' section (shared across Bikol languages, therefore COGNATE-PROBABLE for Virac). Nothing here is independently confirmed for Virac.
_meta.source: project brief, 'Base morphology' + 'Confirmed distinctive features' sections

reduplication.note: CV- or full-root reduplication marks aspect/plurality; a reduplicated form is ONE root, never two.

discourse_particles_note: Must NOT be split off as affixes. No glosses supplied by the brief.

non_virac_contrast_forms.an: Brief: Naga Bikol (bcl) topic marker; Virac uses 'su'.
non_virac_contrast_forms.dai: Brief: Naga Bikol (bcl) negation; Virac uses 'dài'.
non_virac_contrast_forms.mayò: Brief: Naga Bikol (bcl) existential negation; Virac uses 'daing'.

non_virac_contrast_forms_note: These are NOT Viracnon lexicon entries. The segmenter only attaches the note; it never glosses them as Viracnon.
affixable_pos_note: Lexicon entries whose POS is listed here may serve as roots inside unknown words. Function words (pronouns, articles, negation, interrogatives, particles) are excluded so that e.g. 'na'+'ta' is not analysed as prefix + pronoun.
